d: Europe is considering a controversial plan to send rejected asylum seekers to Rwanda. Germany, Austria, Greece, Denmark and the Netherlands are exploring the idea of setting up deportation hubs outside the European Union. The proposal comes amid growing pressure on European governments to curb irregular migration. But serious questions remain about human rights, legal safeguards and Rwanda's record. Britain attempted a similar arrangement but abandoned it after a major legal battle. So, what makes Europe think it can succeed where Britain failed? Is this a solution to Europe's migration…
